function.name: create_ticket
function.description: Creates a support ticket so a human specialist follows up. Use it when the caller asks for a human, needs something you cannot do, has a complaint, reports fraud, cannot be verified, or asks something you have no information about. Works for verified and unverified callers. Pass a short, clear summary in description. The tool decides the priority. Only after the caller agrees, set confirmed to yes.

customer_id.description: The customer ID the caller gave, if any

security_answer.description: The security answer the caller gave, if any

category.description: A one-word topic hint, like fraud, card, transfer, loan, fees, account, complaint

description.description: A short summary: what happened, what the caller wants, and what was already done

confirmed.description: yes only if the caller agreed to the ticket. Otherwise leave out.
